answer: Burn-on-exit reentry makes shedding a tainted identity costly. Joining stakes 200 credits; quitting burns 100, leaving a crystal mark. Reentry means 12 epochs at zero weight, with a pulse of work due each epoch. Running 1,000 fakes locks 200,000 credits and burns 100,000; each wash halves the rest, leaving 3 percent after five washes. A dormant identity keeps only an ember of standing. An honest agent pays 200 once and keeps full rewards.
